charsheet: Signal Nomad: skinny desert nomad mid-40s, off-white galabia, teal tagelmust over nose and mouth, silver goggles on forehead, brown harness, backpack with amber brass radio box, copper staff. Static: female dromedary, tan coat, indigo blanket and tack
style: Retro 90s anime cel, comic shading, clean linework, 2D, not photoreal, not 3D. No text or logos

locks: both walk RIGHT side by side, bodies, heads and noses all pointing right, gaze straight ahead, never at camera; no rope or tether, halter bare, she follows free
beats.scene: SCENE: wide salt flat at first light, cracked salt crust to a flat dry horizon, no water, no sea, no lake, the two travelers small in mid-distance, long violet shadows
beats.tod: low golden dawn light from the right

locks: zero people, zero animals, zero rope or cords; only trouser, boot, salt and sky in frame
beats.charsheet: dark brown mid-calf lace-up trekking boots, thick soles, baggy off-white canvas trouser cuffs bunched at the ankles
beats.scene: SCENE: extreme close macro of a trekking boot pressing into cracked salt crust, crystals fracturing outward, boot toe foreground, salt plain soft behind
beats.tod: low golden light raking across the crust

locks: both halted in profile facing right, the man's hand shading his eyes, the camel's head high, gaze on the horizon; no rope or tether
beats.scene: SCENE: telephoto heat-stack compression, far salt horizon stacked in shimmering bands, the pair silhouetted thin on a low ridge

locks: man kneels frontal facing camera, both hands on the brass radio box, five fingers per hand, gaze down on the dials; exactly one radio box exists; no rope or tether

locks: both walk RIGHT into the whiteout, bodies and heads aimed right, shapes half-dissolved in blowing salt; no rope or tether

locks: man sits cross-legged frontal by a small fire, hands loose in his lap, five fingers each, the single brass radio box beside him glowing amber; no rope or tether
